metrics.duplicateOpportunityRate: One minus unique expected pain-point clusters divided by generated opportunities. Lower is better.
metrics.citationCoverage: Generated opportunities with at least one traceable citation divided by all generated opportunities. Higher is better.
metrics.clusteringPrecision: Correct predicted same-cluster source pairs divided by all predicted same-cluster source pairs. A system predicting no pairs scores zero.
metrics.clusteringRecall: Correct predicted same-cluster source pairs divided by all expected same-cluster source pairs.
metrics.rankingAgreement: Pairwise comparisons where current ordering matches the approved preference divided by all comparisons.
metrics.repeatability: Identical deterministic result fingerprints divided by repeated executions.
